techniques.name: Brute Force
recommended_actions: Lock or reset credentials for the targeted account(s)
Enforce MFA on the affected authentication endpoint
Block or rate-limit the source IP at the perimeter

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol (C2)
recommended_actions: Isolate the affected host from the network
Capture full packet data for the suspicious session before isolation
Hunt for the C2 indicator across EDR telemetry fleet-wide

techniques.name: Phishing
recommended_actions: Quarantine the message fleet-wide and block the sender domain
Reset credentials if the user reports entering them on a linked page
Notify affected recipients and check for further forwarding

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
recommended_actions: Force a credential reset and revoke active sessions
Review recent account activity for privilege changes or data access
Confirm with the account owner via an out-of-band channel

techniques.name: Data Encrypted for Impact (Ransomware)
recommended_actions: Isolate affected hosts immediately and disable shared network paths
Activate the incident response / ransomware playbook
Identify patient zero and preserve forensic images before remediation

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
recommended_actions: Collect the full process command line and parent process chain
Determine whether the script executed from a trusted software deployment tool
Sandbox-detonate any dropped payload for further analysis
